description:
GUIDE PRICE £260,000 - £290,000. 

Situated on the first floor of the highly desirable Woodbourne development, this beautifully presented apartment offers an exceptional combination of character, style, and convenience. Set within the sought-after suburb of Edgbaston, the property enjoys easy access to Birmingham city centre and Harborne, both offering an excellent range of shops, restaurants, and amenities. Despite its central location, the development is surrounded by picturesque communal grounds, creating a peaceful, countryside feel. The property also benefits from a share of the freehold, offering owners an added level of security and involvement in the management of the development.

The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall with useful built-in storage, leading into a bright and spacious open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area. Large patio doors flood the space with natural light and open onto a private balcony overlooking the attractive communal grounds, providing the perfect spot to relax. The apartment features a generous principal bedroom with built-in wardrobes, a well-proportioned second bedroom, a stylish four-piece family bathroom, and the added convenience of a separate WC.

Beautifully decorated throughout with plenty of personality and flair, this unique home has been thoughtfully styled to create a warm and inviting atmosphere. Further benefits include a private garage, communal parking, and the tranquil setting of this prestigious development, making it an ideal home for professionals, downsizers, or those seeking a peaceful retreat within easy reach of the city.
keyFeatures: Beautifully presented first-floor apartment in the sought-after Woodbourne development.
Prime Edgbaston location, within easy reach of Birmingham city centre and Harborne.
Set within stunning communal grounds offering a peaceful, countryside feel
Bright open-plan kitchen, dining and living area with private balcony overlooking the grounds
Decorated throughout with character, personality and contemporary style
An ideal home combining tranquillity, convenience and excellent local amenities
